name: Xenora Minerals Limited
summary: Xenora Minerals Limited is an enterprise dedicated to the discovery and assessment of mineral deposits throughout Australia and Canada. The company's exploration activities encompass a wide array of valuable commodities, including gold, uranium, lithium, copper, zinc, lead, and nickel, along with other base and precious metals. Originally incorporated in 2014 under the name Trinex Minerals Limited, the firm officially adopted its current identity, Xenora Minerals Limited, in September 2025. Its headquarters are situated in Subiaco, Australia.
